forms.name: Petrified Axe
forms.text:
Made using a fossil from
the Wycademy. The default
Switch Axe for Bherna Hunters.

forms.name: Scholarly Axe
forms.text:
The Petrified Axe's final form.
A product of the Wycademy's
tireless research.

forms.name: Sophos Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Petrified Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Arzuros Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe that combines an
iron blade with Arzuros plate.
It boasts Sharpness and strength.

forms.name: Arzuros Revelax
forms.text:
The Arzuros Axe's final form.
It can easily knock aside its prey
with the strength of an Arzuros.

forms.name: Arzuros Jubilax
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Arzuros Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Motor Burst
forms.text:
A broad Switch Axe requiring
great strength to use. One
swing sends foes flying.

forms.name: Gigant Burst
forms.text:
The final form of the Motor
Burst. The massive blade can
be used to topple mountains.

forms.name: Giganceladus
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Motor Burst</COL>.

forms.name: Dios Axe
forms.text:
An explosive Switch Axe. High-
tech construction allows the slime
inside to move where it's needed.

forms.name: Grand Slasher
forms.text:
The Dios Axe's final form.
The slime inside is capable of
attacking with explosive force.

forms.name: Magnificent Slasher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dios Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Demolition Axe
forms.text:
An explosive Switch Axe with a
Brachydios's power. Foes suffer
twice before they hit the ground.

forms.name: Brisant Demolisher
forms.text:
The Demolition Axe's final
form, it can create an explosion
capable of leveling an entire city.

forms.name: Brisant Annihilator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demolition Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Lightbreak Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe whose glare evokes a
Brachydios's wrath. The mechanism
triggers a whole wave of blasts.

forms.name: Lightbreak Intent
forms.text:
The Lightbreak Axe's final form.
Its mechanism has been pushed to
the limits of explosive power.

forms.name: Lightbreak Target
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lightbreak Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Reckless Hatchet
forms.text:
A Tetsucabra Switch Axe that
summons forth the waves, and
leaves beautiful trails of water.

forms.name: Vine Splitter
forms.text:
The Reckless Hatchet's final
form. Sword and Axe combine
to devastate the enemy.

forms.name: Audacious Hatchet
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Reckless Hatchet</COL>.

forms.name: Obsidian Axe
forms.text:
An axe made from a beautiful
fossil. The refined stone has
been reborn as a shiny axe.

forms.name: Relic Axe
forms.text:
The Obsidian Axe's final form.
Capable of unleashing a powerful
attack that clears a path.

forms.name: Ethereal Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Obsidian Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Bolt Axe
forms.text:
An axe that channels the
Lagiacrus's power. With each
slash, azure light blooms.

forms.name: High Bolt Axe
forms.text:
The Bolt Axe's final form. Its
electric currents have reached
their highest voltage.

forms.name: Extreme Bolt Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bolt Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Volt Axe
forms.text:
An axe mantled in lightning.
A weapon worthy of the Lord
of the Seas.

forms.name: Megavolt Axe
forms.text:
The Volt Axe's final form, it
channels the anger of the Lord
of the Seas to summon lightning.

forms.name: Gigavolt Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Volt Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Heavy Divider
forms.text:
A Switch Axe designed to remove
a flying wyvern's head from its
neck. It's stronger than steel.

forms.name: Grunhart
forms.text:
The Heavy Divider's final form,
it is known for its ability to smash
mountains with its heavy blows.

forms.name: Grunfest
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Heavy Divider</COL>.

forms.name: Iron Axe
forms.text:
A simple Switch Axe that serves
as the basis for most Switch
Axes. Has limitless potential.

forms.name: Araxxis
forms.text:
The Iron Axe's final iteration.
It has been carefully upgraded
to give it outstanding durability.

forms.name: Alter Araxxis
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Iron Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Scissor Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made of Hermitaur
materials. It can change form
freely and sounds like the surf.

forms.name: Megatalon Shears
forms.text:
The Scissor Axe's final form
features twin blades resembling
Hermitaur claws that rip into prey.

forms.name: Colossoclaw Shears
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Scissor Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Exoskeleton Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from insect
materials that feature hardened
shells and a paralytic agent.

forms.name: Exoskeleton Chopper
forms.text:
The Exoskeleton Axe's final form.
Its blade shines brightly due to
its use of high quality materials.

forms.name: Exoskeleton Hacker
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Exoskeleton Axe</COL>.

forms.name: The Shredder
forms.text:
A mechanical Switch Axe made
using the latest technology. It
generates incredible power.

forms.name: The Power Shredder
forms.text:
The Shredder's final form.
Its power source has been juiced
for maximum shredding potential.

forms.name: The Lightning Shredder
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>The Shredder</COL>.

forms.name: Dream Captor
forms.text:
A Switch Axe based on Malfestio
talons, it uses its three talons to
trap prey in a living nightmare.

forms.name: Somniferous Talon
forms.text:
The Dream Captor's final form.
Swipes from this axe can easily
bend both dreams and reality.

forms.name: Hypnotic Talon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dream Captor</COL>.

forms.name: Elite Switch Axe
forms.text:
An official Guild Switch
Axe. This standard model is
often used by outriders.

forms.name: Czar Switch Axe
forms.text:
The Elite Switch Axe's final
form. Its sharpened blade has
seen many bloody battles.

forms.name: Valor Switch Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elite Switch Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Dragonmaiden Axe
forms.text:
An axe bestowed to a bold,
beautiful battle maiden whom
no bloodstain could sully.

forms.name: Gríðr's Landmaker
forms.text:
The Dragonmaiden Axe's final
form makes maidens beautiful
even if they're bathed in blood.

forms.name: Gríðr's Landforger
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dragonmaiden Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Golden Crescent
forms.text:
The golden rays of moonlight
contained in this axe illuminated
a queen's march into darkness.

forms.name: Lune Shredder
forms.text:
The Golden Crescent's final form.
Its moonbeams split the dark
and purify the bloodstained.

forms.name: Harvest Moon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Golden Crescent</COL>.

forms.name: Aksa Switch
forms.text:
A vicious Seregios Switch Axe.
Evading repeatedly while drawn
restores some Sharpness.

forms.name: Baran Defiance
forms.text:
The Aksa Switch's final form.
It is wielded by those with an
unquenched spirit of rebellion.

forms.name: Baran Rebellion
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Aksa Switch</COL>.

forms.name: Seditious Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made for slaughter.
Evading repeatedly while drawn
restores some Sharpness.

forms.name: Baraq Sedition
forms.text:
The final form of the Seditious
Axe, an emblem of strength for
those who choose to rebel.

forms.name: Sedition Splitter
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Seditious Axe</COL>.

forms.name: General's Strongaxe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe given to hunters who
do great deeds for the Guild. Its
gold emblem is a badge of honor.

forms.name: Conqueress
forms.text:
The final form of the General's
Strongaxe, it is proof of a warrior
who has fought in many battles.

forms.name: Reconqueress
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>General's Strongaxe</COL>.

forms.name: Beak Axe
forms.text:
A weapon made from a Yian
Kut-Ku's beak, polished to
a wicked sharpness.

forms.name: Sawbill Axe
forms.text:
The Beak Axe's final form. Like the
raging Yian Kut-Ku, it slashes through
all in its path, leaving ash in its wake.

forms.name: Terror Bird Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Beak Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Notched Doom
forms.text:
An axe with an edge sanded
as even as possible for
equal power and durability.

forms.name: Notched Legion
forms.text:
The final form of Notched
Doom. It can hit with the force
of a Zamtrios bite.

forms.name: Notched Rout
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Notched Doom</COL>.

forms.name: Notched Tyrant
forms.text:
An axe liberally lined with
Zamtrios fangs. Bores into
the very bones of prey.

forms.name: Notched Oppressor
forms.text:
A Switch Axe designed to look
like a Zamtrios fang, it is the
Notched Tyrant's final form.

forms.name: Notched Ice Autarch
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Notched Tyrant</COL>.

forms.name: Bone Axe
forms.text:
A standard bone-based Switch
Axe, it is the latest advancement
in desert-based weaponry.

forms.name: Daidalos Axe
forms.text:
The Bone Axe's final form, it
has been upgraded by a master
craftsman to deal extra damage.

forms.name: Ikaros Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bone Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Bruiser Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe put together from
Jaggi and Ioprey parts. Inspires
one to explore new frontiers.

forms.name: Chief Bruiser Axe
forms.text:
The Bruiser Axe's final form.
It is the perfect tool for forging
new paths into the unknown.

forms.name: Emperor Bruiser Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bruiser Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Ludroth Axe
forms.text:
An axe made from Royal Ludroth
parts. Switching between modes
is as smooth as flowing water.

forms.name: Splish Splax
forms.text:
The Ludroth Axe's final form.
It unleashes a torrent of water
that floods all around it.

forms.name: Ludroth Drencher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ludroth Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Finslash
forms.text:
An elegant Switch Axe made from
a Plesioth. Its brilliant fins can
slice adversaries to ribbons.

forms.name: Mega Rhipidon
forms.text:
The Finslash's final form, it
attacks the enemy with Poison
and its sharpened blade.

forms.name: Cascade Rhipidon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Finslash</COL>.

forms.name: Power Gasher
forms.text:
A basic Switch Axe with
few visual differences but
a more capable construction.

forms.name: Maximal Gasher
forms.text:
The Power Gasher's final form.
Incremental improvements have
improved it beyond measure.

forms.name: Powerhouse Gasher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Power Gasher</COL>.

forms.name: Rath Flame Splitter
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Rathalos materials.
Facilitates igniting attacks.

forms.name: Rath Blaze Splitter
forms.text:
The Rath Flame Splitter's
final form turns its user
into the king of hellfire.

forms.name: Rath Inferno Splitter
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rath Flame Splitter</COL>.

forms.name: Rathsplicer
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from rare
and precious materials.
Ignites with more force.

forms.name: Rathlagration
forms.text:
The Rathsplicer's final form.
It floods the land with the fires
of a Silver Rathalos's vengeance.

forms.name: Rathscension
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rathsplicer</COL>.

forms.name: Vavoom Axe
forms.text:
Supple Kecha Wacha material
in the joints enables smooth
morphs and lethal attacks.

forms.name: Vavoom Verdict
forms.text:
The Vavoom Axe's final form.
It uses fluid movements to deceive
its prey before cutting them down.

forms.name: Vavoom Victory
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Vavoom Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Vavoom Vengeance
forms.text:
A redesign focused on power
and rigidity. Extra weight
punches it up even more.

forms.name: Vavoom Vindication
forms.text:
The Vavoom Vengeance's final
form. The sharpened blade easily
cuts through wyvern hide.

forms.name: Weird Wacha Nakha
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Vavoom Vengeance</COL>.

forms.name: Golba Vandal
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from Congalala
spoils. A supremely tough weapon,
and smells absolutely divine.

forms.name: Gundava Vandal
forms.text:
The Golba Vandal's final form.
Veteran of a thousand battles,
neither its strength nor scent fade.

forms.name: Gundar Sangram
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Golba Vandal</COL>.

forms.name: Assault Axe
forms.text:
A versatile hunting axe. In
Sword Mode, it pumps paralyzing
agents into targets.

forms.name: Blitzkrieg
forms.text:
The Assault Axe's final form.
Its overwhelming power
dominates any hunting ground.

forms.name: Bastion Blitz
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Assault Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Hidden Axe
forms.text:
An ebon Switch Axe, dark as
night. So fast, its swings are
nearly invisible.

forms.name: Night's Crescent
forms.text:
The Hidden Axe's final form.
Its light brings death to its victims
as it illuminates the night sky.

forms.name: Avidya Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hidden Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Amber Slash
forms.text:
A lovely hunting axe made
from the tri-color Barioth.
Cold enough to freeze blood.

forms.name: Amber Hoarfrost
forms.text:
The Amber Slash's final form is cold
enough to beckon death, and
caresses its prey with crimson ice.

forms.name: Amber Permafrost
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Amber Slash</COL>.

forms.name: Galefrost
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from superior
Barioth fangs. All who meet it
suffer the grave's cold embrace.

forms.name: Giga Galefrost
forms.text:
The Galefrost's final form boasts a
blade chilled to absolute zero.
One swish extinguishes life's flame.

forms.name: Amberfang
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Galefrost</COL>.

forms.name: Usurper's Downpour
forms.text:
A Switch Axe born from the finest
hunter in history. Its lightning
heralds the return of the king.

forms.name: Despot's Cloudburst
forms.text:
The final form of the Usurper's
Downpour, it is for those that
believe might makes right.

forms.name: Oppressor's Deluge
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Usurper's Downpour</COL>.

forms.name: Wild Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe akin to a blunt
weapon. Lighter than it looks,
it can be wielded with ease.

forms.name: Ground Dasher
forms.text:
The Wild Axe's final form.
It uses the tusks of wild
beasts to cut down its prey.

forms.name: Giganto-Dasher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Wild Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Flickaxe
forms.text:
The arched Najarala neck
makes prey freeze in terror
long before they can resist.

forms.name: Flick Helix
forms.text:
The Flickaxe's final form,
its repulsive gaze sends victims
into the depths of despair.

forms.name: Flick Angriff
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Flickaxe</COL>.

forms.name: Flicker Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made with the soul
of a Najarala. Touching the blade
traps one in eternal nightmares.

forms.name: Paraflick Axe
forms.text:
The final form of the Flicker
Axe, its victims' souls can never
wake from endless nightmare.

forms.name: Paracrux Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Flicker Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Binding Roller
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from the
tough, elastic shell of a Volvidon.
It's surprisingly flexible.

forms.name: Vermilingua
forms.text:
The Binding Roller's final form.
As it cuts down foes, its vermilion
blade pulses ever darker.

forms.name: Vermilion Bloodaxe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Binding Roller</COL>.

forms.name: Rex Slasher
forms.text:
A fine Switch Axe that makes
daring use of Tigrex parts
in its delicate mechanisms.

forms.name: Rex Gnasher
forms.text:
The Rex Slasher's final form
enables the battle roar of its user
to be heard throughout the land.

forms.name: Rex Thrasher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rex Slasher</COL>.

forms.name: Fire Tempest
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from the
beak of the Agnaktor, which
resides in a sea of magma.

forms.name: Flame Tempest
forms.text:
The Fire Tempest's final form.
Those struck down by this blade
are instantly turned to dust.

forms.name: Helstrong Firebath
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fire Tempest</COL>.

forms.name: Axe Semper Tyrannis
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from the
spiked armor of a Diablos. It
rends flesh right off the bone.

forms.name: Grand Chaos
forms.text:
The Axe Semper Tyrannis's final
form attacks without mercy. Its
wielder will rule the desert.

forms.name: Axe of Gaia
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Axe Semper Tyrannis</COL>.

forms.name: Yukumo Switch Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made of high quality
wood and metal. Hunters love its
strength and versatility.

forms.name: Yukumo Axe
forms.text:
The Yukumo Switch Axe's final
form. Using the finest materials, it
has been greatly improved.

forms.name: Hot Spring Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Yukumo Switch Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Yukumo Pure Axe
forms.text:
This Switch Axe utilizes wood
of uncanny hardness to give it
both strength and lightness.

forms.name: Yukumo Spirit Axe
forms.text:
The Yukumo Pure Axe's final
form. It has been refined to give
maximum destructive capacity.

forms.name: Yukumo Aura Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Yukumo Pure Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Grim Cat
forms.text:
A Switch Axe depicting a cat
with an eerie grin. It smiles
even when its Sharpness drops.

forms.name: Grimmige Katze
forms.text:
The Grim Cat's final form.
Even if one tries to destroy the
blade, the cat merely grins.

forms.name: Felyne Fatality
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Grim Cat</COL>.

forms.name: Rough Edge
forms.text:
A stone axe made of ancient
ore, and an embodiment of
the unyielding human spirit.

forms.name: Soulbreaker
forms.text:
The Rough Edge's final form.
The rage of the ancient spirit
within gives its blade strength.

forms.name: Helios Crusher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rough Edge</COL>.

forms.name: Arctic Ledge
forms.text:
The grand prize for a sled race in
the Arctic Ridge. Its design
is based on last year's winner.

forms.name: Ledge Axe
forms.text:
The final form of the Arctic
Ledge. Its red and white design
is from last year's winner's outfit.

forms.name: Axledge Icerunner
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Arctic Ledge</COL>.

forms.name: Gouda Axe
forms.text:
Using only the best quality cheese,
this Switch Axe looks great, tastes
great, and is quite Sharp!

forms.name: Aged Gouda Axe
forms.text:
The Gouda Axe's final form.
So much cheesy goodness,
it just has to be shared.

forms.name: Boerenkaas Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Gouda Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Fond Farewell
forms.text:
An elegant Switch Axe left behind
by a beautiful maiden. The sound
made by its slice is terrifying.

forms.name: Parting Slice
forms.text:
The Fond Farewell's final form.
Cries from its victims echo in the
night as it welcomes the dawn.

forms.name: Leave-Taker
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fond Farewell</COL>.

forms.name: Voltaic Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from Astalos
materials. Its attacks are charged
with electrical energy.

forms.name: Voltaic End
forms.text:
The Voltaic Axe's final form.
Its might can bring even the
kingdom of hell to its knees.

forms.name: Voltaic Load
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Voltaic Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Giant's Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe once used by a
mountain maiden. A maker of
miracles and mover of spirits.

forms.name: Colossus's Axe
forms.text:
The final form of the Giant's
Axe. It serves as a call to arms
from the mountain maidens.

forms.name: Behemoth's Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Giant's Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Scorching Drafa
forms.text:
The flames that shoot forth
when this Switch Axe transforms
terrifies its unfortunate foes.

forms.name: Glavenus's Grimace
forms.text:
The Scorching Drafa's final form,
it uses the flames of the Glavenus
to incinerate its enemies.

forms.name: Glavenus's Grimanova
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Scorching Drafa</COL>.

forms.name: Eisenleib
forms.text:
A wicked axe favored by the
grimmest of reapers. Its dark
flash tears apart the light.

forms.name: Eisengeist
forms.text:
The Eisenleib's final form.
The flash of its blade is an
invitation to the gates of hell.

forms.name: Eisenherz
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Eisenleib</COL>.

forms.name: La Guillotine
forms.text:
A Switch Axe said to be used by
the one that guides souls to the
afterlife. It cuts through darkness.

forms.name: Le Sursis
forms.text:
The final form of La Guillotine,
its divine guiding light dispels evil
and darkness from the land.

forms.name: La Conclusion
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>La Guillotine</COL>.

forms.name: Peal
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from Kirin
spoils. It makes a valuable
weapon AND display item.

forms.name: Kirin Thunderpeal
forms.text:
The Peal's final form strikes
down opponents with bolts of
divine judgment.

forms.name: Archbeast Kirin
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Peal</COL>.

forms.name: Daora's Farasa
forms.text:
A Switch Axe with wings of steel.
Its deep cold is said to drink
the life force of the wielder.

forms.name: Daora's Janah
forms.text:
The final form of Daora's
Farasa. Its cold steel wings can
freeze even the inferno of hell.

forms.name: Daora's Ajniha
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Daora's Farasa</COL>.

forms.name: Waxglare Wand
forms.text:
A Switch Axe with twitching eyes.
The hungry tongue darts at prey
faster than desert air changes.

forms.name: Balor's Mirage
forms.text:
The Waxglare Wand's final
form. A demonic axe, it takes
the life of all who enter its gaze.

forms.name: Zariella's Phantasm
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Waxglare Wand</COL>.

forms.name: Skeletal Axe
forms.text:
A terrifying Switch Axe whose
blades decimate those foolish
enough to stand before it.

forms.name: Wicked Thorns
forms.text:
The Skeletal Axe's final
form. Its wielders are driven
mad by the ecstasy of carnage.

forms.name: Antares Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Skeletal Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Polaris Skalvia
forms.text:
This Switch Axe brings about a
rebirth as each swing shines
with the light of the cosmos.

forms.name: Cosmic Skalve
forms.text:
The Polaris Skalvia's final form.
The light of the cosmos gives
new life to the restless dead.

forms.name: Starfire Skalve
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Polaris Skalvia</COL>.

forms.name: Wycademy Axe
forms.text:
Bearing the name of the Wycademy,
it's known for its contribution
to monster "research."

forms.name: Versa Veil Axe
forms.text:
The Wycademy Axe's final
form. Its power will rip monsters
a new one...for science.

forms.name: Granversa Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Wycademy Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Infernal Axe
forms.text:
An axe based on a cruel and
merciless demon. The fierce
tip reaps the souls of its foes.

forms.name: Hellish Edge
forms.text:
The Infernal Axe's final form.
It continues to take countless
lives with merciless glee.

forms.name: Calamitous Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Infernal Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Black Belt Axe
forms.text:
The culmination of blood and
sweat shed in the arena. It
has overcome many dangers.

forms.name: Shihan Axe
forms.text:
The Black Belt Axe's final
form. It contains the souls
taken from many battles.

forms.name: Grandmaster Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Black Belt Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Black Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe that harbors a
dark force that controls the
wielder with fear and anxiety.

forms.name: Onyx Axe
forms.text:
The Black Axe's final form.
It sews a path of fear across the
world, until all is chaos.

forms.name: Fatalis End
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Black Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Undying Axe
forms.text:
A black Switch Axe with untold
strength. It resembles a Rajang
horn piercing the heavens.

forms.name: Undying Light
forms.text:
The Undying Axe's final form.
The unleashed soul of the Rajang
rends all darkness.

forms.name: Undying Purity
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Undying Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Demonlord Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe harboring demonic
fury. The cosmos cowers before
its golden bursts of lightning.

forms.name: Demonlord Edge
forms.text:
The Demonlord Axe's final
form. It is the manifestation of
pure rage that engulfs the land.

forms.name: Demonlord Earthshaker
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demonlord Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Tyrannos
forms.text:
A Switch Axe that embodies a
voracious Deviljho. Scars from
past battles line the surface.

forms.name: Terror Tyrannos
forms.text:
The Tyrannos's final form.
The embodiment of evil, greed,
and murderous intent.

forms.name: Nero's Tyrannos
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Tyrannos</COL>.

forms.name: Saligia Vileaxe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe forged with blood
from a brutal Deviljho. Leads
wielders to a life of butchery.

forms.name: Saligia Enderaxe
forms.text:
The Saligia Vileaxe's final
form brings nothingness and
sheer devastation.

forms.name: Doomaxe "Downpour"
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Saligia Vileaxe</COL>.

forms.name: Research Axe
forms.text:
This Switch Axe serves as scissors.
Useful for when the Soaratorium air
sacs are being serviced.

forms.name: Discovery Axe
forms.text:
The Research Axe's final form.
It follows that those with a keen
mind also possess a keen blade.

forms.name: Authority Shears
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Research Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Switch Fox
forms.text:
A special Famitsu weapon,
its impressive fox design is
mysteriously alluring.

forms.name: Special Corps Axe
forms.text:
The Switch Fox's final form.
Its morphing blade mirrors
the changes in the world.

forms.name: Shapeshifter
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Switch Fox</COL>.

forms.name: Raikou Works
forms.text:
A gold and blue axe from a
foreign land. Its blade strikes
with pulsing lightning.

forms.name: Raiden Works
forms.text:
The Raikou Works's final
form. The blade's charge can
tear the heavens asunder.

forms.name: Dengeki Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Raikou Works</COL>.

forms.name: Pirate Axe J
forms.text:
The flag used by the master
of the seven seas. His pride
lives on in the left eye.

forms.name: Buccaneer Axe J
forms.text:
The Pirate Axe J's final form.
Dreams, volition, pride... This
blade forges its own legend.

forms.name: Pirate King Axe J
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Pirate Axe J</COL>.

forms.name: Akantor Switch Axe
forms.text:
An axe whose dark, divine
passenger shall rule in the
fallen world's second life.

forms.name: Akantor Divider
forms.text:
The Akantor Switch Axe's final
form. It spills into this world the
chaos of an ancient land.

forms.name: Akantor Fissure
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Akantor Switch Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Murkham Axe
forms.text:
Embodiment of the white god's
thirteenth power: an axe that
can split the world.

forms.name: Muronkham Axe
forms.text:
The Murkham Axe's final
form. The axe was used by the
gods to carve out a new world.

forms.name: Murkhanomi Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Murkham Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Cloudburst Axe
forms.text:
An axe wielded by the gods.
It calls the rain of judgment
to pour from the skies.

forms.name: Heavenly Rain
forms.text:
The Cloudburst Axe's final
form. Its shower of light washes
away the sins of the masses.

forms.name: Celestial Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cloudburst Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Dark Switch Axe
forms.text:
A dreadful Switch Axe shaped
after an Alatreon horn, dark
as the primordial dawn.

forms.name: Black Harvest
forms.text:
The Dark Switch Axe's final
form. When its true master is
found, a night of dragons awaits.

forms.name: Altheos Voracion
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dark Switch Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Silverwing Switch Axe
forms.text:
One swing from the Argent Comet's
axe and all that remains is stardust
and the ashes of your enemies.

forms.name: Dragonstar Dunat
Magnastar Batis
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Silverwing Switch Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Elder Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe from the Soaratorium
for hunters breaking new ground.
Boasts stunning destructive power.

forms.name: Sage Axe
forms.text:
The Elder Axe's final form.
Tears prey thoroughly to pieces
with its exceptionally sharp blade.

forms.name: Philosopher Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elder Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Gorgonzola Axe
forms.text:
Get a taste of the finest blue
cheese! A pungently refined
luxury to thrill true connoisseurs.

forms.name: Aged Gorgonzola Axe
forms.text:
The Gorgonzola Axe's final form.
Go on, treat yourself to a bite!
You've earned it, Hunter!

forms.name: Gorgonzola Piccante
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Gorgonzola Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Inceadeus
forms.text:
A legendary Switch Axe
carved from a Ceadeus horn.
It glows white from within.

forms.name: Great Inceadeus
forms.text:
The Great Inceadeus's final form.
Attacks with the sea-lord's rage,
splitting land and sea alike.

forms.name: Ceadeed Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Inceadeus</COL>.

forms.name: Körper/Esprit
forms.text:
A Switch Axe whose Affinity
changes when its wielder
overcomes the Frenzy.

forms.name: Fleisch/Ame
forms.text:
The Körper/Esprit's final form. Shows
its true potential only to those who
would overcome their mortal limits.

forms.name: Frevel/Sursis
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Körper/Esprit</COL>.

forms.name: Dragon Ripper
forms.text:
Only those who have defeated
the great Lao-Shan Lung are
permitted to touch this Switch Axe.

forms.name: Dragonfire Axe
forms.text:
The Dragon Ripper's final form
has dragons falling like autumn
leaves from the sky.

forms.name: Dragon Eater
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dragon Ripper</COL>.

forms.name: Goldaxe
forms.text:
Golden relic of a lost civilization.
The inscription tells of a mighty
war machine that led an army.

forms.name: Inscribed Astarte
forms.text:
The Goldaxe's final form.
Wielded by a goddess on
horseback. Ride on to battle!

forms.name: Anat Karnaim
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Goldaxe</COL>.

forms.name: Ruiner's Bane
forms.text:
Despair was fated to return
to the world, as was the
fabled axe to be used again.

forms.name: True Ruiner's Bane
forms.text:
The Ruiner's Bane's final form reveals
a world where despair lies beside
hope. Eternal peace is impossible.

forms.name: Absolute Ruiner's Bane
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ruiner's Bane</COL>.

forms.name: Fatalis Force
forms.text:
A demonic Switch Axe used long
ago in ritual sacrifice. Its edge
glows as life fills it.

forms.name: Fatalis Finesse
forms.text:
The Fatalis Force's final form
manifests itself using the bodies
of the slain as an offering.

forms.name: Fatalis Feint
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fatalis Force</COL>.

forms.name: Crimson Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Redhelm parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Redhelm Axe
forms.text:
The Crimson Axe's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Redhelm Arzuros.

forms.name: Red Cloudscraper Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Crimson Axe</COL>!

forms.name: Blackhare Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Snowbaron parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Snowbaron Axe
forms.text:
The Blackhare Axe's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Snowbaron Lagombi.

forms.name: Snowbaron Aurispada
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Blackhare Axe</COL>!

forms.name: Pincher Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Stonefist parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Stonefist Axe
forms.text:
The Pincher Axe's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Stonefist Hermitaur.

forms.name: Stonefist Gigantaxe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Pincher Axe</COL>!

forms.name: Royal Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Dreadqueen parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Dreadqueen Axe
forms.text:
The Royal Axe's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Dreadqueen Rathian.

forms.name: Dreadqueen Cleaver
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Royal Axe</COL>!

forms.name: Pierce Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Drilltusk parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Drilltusk Axe
forms.text:
The Pierce Axe's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Drilltusk Tetsucabra.

forms.name: Tetsucabra Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Pierce Axe</COL>!

forms.name: Nightfall Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Silverwind parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Silverwind Axe
forms.text:
The Nightfall Axe's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Silverwind Nargacuga.

forms.name: Daybreak Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Nightfall Axe</COL>!

forms.name: Geode Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Crystalbeard parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Crystalbeard Axe
forms.text:
The Geode Axe's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Crystalbeard Uragaan.

forms.name: Diamante Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Geode Axe</COL>!

forms.name: Tomb Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Dreadking parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Dreadking Axe
forms.text:
The Tomb Axe's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Dreadking Rathalos.

forms.name: Firewaltz Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Tomb Axe</COL>!

forms.name: Raiden Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Thunderlord parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Thunderlord Axe
forms.text:
The Raiden Axe's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Thunderlord Zinogre.

forms.name: Thunderlord Shocker
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Raiden Axe</COL>!

forms.name: Seize Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Grimclaw parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Grimclaw Axe
forms.text:
The Seize Axe's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Grimclaw Tigrex.

forms.name: Grimclaw Chopper
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Seize Axe</COL>!

forms.name: Magma Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Hellblade parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Hellblade Axe
forms.text:
The Magma Axe's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Hellblade Glavenus.

forms.name: Glaverno Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Magma Axe</COL>!

forms.name: Cloaked Kaleidos
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Nightcloak parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Cloaked Somnolus
forms.text:
The Cloaked Kaleidos's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Nightcloak Malfestio.

forms.name: Cloaked Somnolence
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cloaked Kaleidos</COL>!

forms.name: Deep Yearning
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Soulseer parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Lanternlight Banner
forms.text:
Deep Yearning's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Soulseer Mizutsune.

forms.name: Lanternlight Grave
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Deep Yearning</COL>!

forms.name: Zephra Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Boltreaver Astalos parts. Wielding
it fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Zephra Halberd
forms.text:
The Zephra Axe's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Boltreaver Astalos.

forms.name: Zilvolt Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Zephra Axe</COL>!

forms.name: Elderfrost Switch Axe
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Elderfrost parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Elderfrost Gasher
forms.text:
The Elderfrost Switch Axe's final
form. Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Elderfrost Gammoth.

forms.name: Elderfrost Unleasher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elderfrost Switch Axe</COL>!

forms.name: Massacre Hatchet
forms.text:
A Switch Axe made from
Bloodbath parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Massacre Axe
forms.text:
The Massacre Hatchet's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Bloodbath Diablos.

forms.name: Scipio
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Massacre Hatchet</COL>!

forms.name: Worn Switch Axe
forms.text:
A worn Switch Axe with
unrealized potential. It
could perhaps be restored...

forms.name: Weathered Switch Axe
forms.text:
The Worn Switch Axe's final
form. Unwavering in its strength,
it will never be restored.

forms.name: Aged Switch Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Worn Switch Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Mundus Altus
forms.text:
A transcendent ancient edge
that once parted heaven. The
final severance package.

forms.name: Mundus Regius
forms.text:
The final form of the Mundus
Altus. A weapon reborn from
ancient myths.

forms.name: Mundus Divinus
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Mundus Altus</COL>.

forms.name: Teostra's Arx
forms.text:
A fiery fang in the Flame
Emperor's arsenal. On scarlet
wings, it races through the sky.

forms.name: Teostra's Castle
forms.text:
The final form of Teostra's
Arx, its dragon fire incinerates
the Flame Emperor's enemies.

forms.name: Teostra's Hellebarde
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Teostra's Arx</COL>.
